key_features: USB A to USB C Cable Only: Includes two 6.6FT/2M USB A to USB C cables. A wall charger is not included. The USB A plug connects to a USB A charger, computer, or car port, while the USB C plug connects to a compatible USB C device. This is not a USB C to USB C cable and is not for Lightning or Micro USB ports.

Charging Speed Depends on Your Setup: Supports up to 3A when the charger, device, and charging protocol are compatible. For iPhone 15, 16, and 17 series, charging is limited to up to 7.5W with a compatible USB A power source. For USB C PD fast charging, use a USB C charger and USB C to USB C cable.

Device Compatibility Notes: Works with many USB C phones, tablets, earbuds, and accessories. Samsung fast charging may require a compatible USB A QC or AFC charger. Google Pixel and OnePlus devices may charge at standard speed. It does not support Huawei SuperCharge, OnePlus DASH/WARP, or high-power laptop charging.

Charging and Data Synchronization: Supports charging and data synchronization between compatible USB A and USB C devices. CarPlay and other data functions depend on the vehicle, device, software, and USB port. This cable does not support video output.
Braided Nylon Cable : Double-braided nylon and reinforced connector housings help reduce everyday bending at the cable ends. Braided construction may feel firmer than a soft PVC cable.
Safe-Use Guidance:Use only with undamaged, certified power adapters. Stop use and unplug immediately if the cable or connector becomes unusually hot, discolored, damaged, or produces an odor.
